title: GitHub Trending Summary - Daily - 2026-10-22
ranking_basis: Daily GitHub Trending star gains, descending
ranking_explanation: The nine repositories visible in the GitHub Trending daily view were ordered by the stars gained today displayed on that page. Repository REST metadata and default-branch commits were checked for every listed repository; total stars and language use the GitHub REST metadata fetched at snapshot time.
global_caveat: The snapshot was captured at 2026-10-22 16:21 UTC. GitHub's daily star-gain values and total stars can change during the day and between Trending and REST API requests. No prior-window evidence was collected, so no change-over-time claim is made.

sections.title: Snapshot
sections.content: Snapshot time (UTC): 2026-10-22 16:21 UTC. Scope: Daily. Date range: 2026-10-22 through 2026-10-22. Ranking basis: daily GitHub Trending star gains, descending.

sections.title: Headline
sections.content: Today's strongest signal is demand for agentic developer workflows: Cloudflare's security-audit skill leads with 2,979 stars today, while Ponytail and Graphify also post four-figure gains. The set spans practical agent skills, codebase context, and established application infrastructure rather than one single framework trend.

sections.title: Top Repositories
sections.content: Repositories ranked by daily Trending gains: 1 cloudflare/security-audit-skill (+2,979); 2 DietrichGebert/ponytail (+1,949); 3 Graphify-Labs/graphify (+1,407); 4 supabase/supabase (+683); 5 php/php-src (+423); 6 luongnv89/claude-howto (+370); 7 anthropics/knowledge-work-plugins (+303); 8 Meloong-Git/PCL (+115); 9 fastapi/fastapi (+96).

sections.title: cloudflare/security-audit-skill
sections.description: A coding-agent security audit workflow that structures reconnaissance, hunting, independent validation, and machine-readable reporting.
sections.why_notable: It has the largest daily gain in this snapshot and makes audit findings independently checked and schema-validated.
sections.unique_caveat: GitHub REST metadata showed the latest push on September 14, 2026; today's star surge is not evidence of a new code push today.

sections.title: DietrichGebert/ponytail
sections.description: An agent skill that urges coding agents to understand existing code and choose the smallest safe change before writing.
sections.why_notable: Its daily gain is the second-largest here; its distinctive stop-at-the-first-adequate-solution ladder emphasizes less code and tests for risky logic.
sections.unique_caveat: The README's benchmark figures are project-reported results, not an independent evaluation in this snapshot.

sections.title: Graphify-Labs/graphify
sections.description: Builds a queryable knowledge graph from code and project materials for use from coding assistants.
sections.why_notable: It is the strongest code-understanding signal after the agent skills, with local deterministic AST parsing for code and an explicit graph instead of a vector index.

sections.title: supabase/supabase
sections.description: An open-source Postgres application platform spanning database, authentication, storage, APIs, and realtime.
sections.why_notable: It shows that the day's momentum also reaches integrated backend infrastructure; its README describes a modular set of services around Postgres.

sections.title: php/php-src
sections.description: The source repository for the PHP interpreter.
sections.why_notable: A language-runtime repository stands out among agent-focused tools, and GitHub reports an active default branch today.

sections.title: luongnv89/claude-howto
sections.description: A visual, example-driven guide to Claude Code, from basic use through agent workflows.
sections.why_notable: It reflects developer demand for accessible, reusable guidance around configuring and extending coding agents.

sections.title: anthropics/knowledge-work-plugins
sections.description: Role-oriented plugins for Claude Cowork, also compatible with Claude Code.
sections.why_notable: The repository packages skills, connectors, commands, and sub-agents around job functions, extending agents from coding into repeatable workplace workflows.

sections.title: Meloong-Git/PCL
sections.description: Plain Craft Launcher, a Minecraft launcher.
sections.why_notable: It is a non-AI counterpoint in the list and the only Visual Basic .NET project in this snapshot.

sections.title: fastapi/fastapi
sections.description: A Python framework for building APIs.
sections.why_notable: Its continued daily activity alongside Supabase and PHP-src indicates durable interest in production application foundations, even as agent tools dominate the largest gains.

sections.title: Trending Technologies and Themes
sections.content:
- Coding-agent workflows: Cloudflare's security-audit-skill, Ponytail, and claude-howto focus on audit orchestration, minimal safe code changes, and practical agent use. Anthropic's knowledge-work-plugins broadens the same workflow pattern into role-specific workplace software.
- Codebase context and retrieval: Graphify-Labs/graphify turns code and project materials into an explainable graph; its README highlights local deterministic parsing of code and no vector store.
- Application backends and runtimes: Supabase combines Postgres with auth, storage, APIs, and realtime; FastAPI and php-src represent API development and a mature language runtime.
- Languages: Among these nine repos, Python appears four times, JavaScript twice, and C, TypeScript, and Visual Basic .NET once each. This is a directional count of today's list, not a measure of GitHub-wide language share.

sections.title: Takeaway
sections.content: Agent tooling is the clearest daily momentum cluster, especially skills that constrain agent behavior with explicit workflows, verification, or smaller changes. At the same time, Graphify's graph-based code context and gains for established backend projects point to a broader demand for tools that make software systems easier to understand and operate. The star gains are a one-day attention signal, not a substitute for adoption or quality measures.

sections.title: Sources and Method
sections.content: Primary source: https://github.com/trending?since=daily, viewed 2026-10-22. Corroboration: GitHub REST API repository metadata and default-branch commits for all nine repos; GitHub Search API exact-name matches for php/php-src, cloudflare/security-audit-skill, and fastapi/fastapi. Exact-name search did not return every repo, so REST API metadata was the corroborating source for those entries. Ranking uses the displayed daily Trending gains, descending. No prior-window comparison was collected; Notable Shifts is omitted.
